import subprocess,json,pathlib,urllib.request,urllib.parse,urllib.error
container="deploy-gaybbs-1"
inspect=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect",container],text=True))[0]
source=next(m["Source"] for m in inspect["Mounts"] if m["Destination"]=="/run/secrets/bot_token")
token=pathlib.Path(source).read_text().strip()
base="https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/"
def invoke(method,params):
 try:
  body=urllib.parse.urlencode(params).encode()
  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+method,data=body),timeout=20) as res:
   obj=json.load(res)
  return obj.get("ok") is True,str(obj.get("description",""))[:180]
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
  try: obj=json.load(e); return False,str(obj.get("description","HTTP_ERROR"))[:180]
  except Exception: return False,"HTTP_ERROR"
 except Exception as e: return False,type(e).__name__
getme=request=urllib.request.urlopen(base+"getMe",timeout=20)
me=json.load(getme)
if not me.get("ok"): raise RuntimeError("BOT_GETME_FAILED")
bot_id=me["result"]["id"]
ok_member,member_note=invoke("getChatMember",{"chat_id":-1003847210571,"user_id":bot_id})
ok_thread,thread_note=invoke("sendChatAction",{"chat_id":-1003847210571,"message_thread_id":48,"action":"typing"})
